title: Sept 11 2001 Newspaper Special Section Americas Darkest Day Ventura County Star
descriptionText:
Original Ventura County Sunday Star special section newspaper dated Sept. 16, 2001 titled “Sept. 11, 2001 America’s darkest day.”
This is an authentic period newspaper released shortly after the September 11 attacks. Paper shows age related wear including folding creases, corner wear, and small staple holes along the lower edge. Please review photos carefully for exact condition.
Great historical collectible, research piece, or display item.
